_about: The LRHS mark library: one source of truth read by the deck (deck/slides-lrhs.js, deck/render-boards.mjs), the printable PDF (deck/build-pdf.mjs) and the site (src/app/case-study/lakewood-ranch-redesign). Files live in public/images/lrhs-marks. ground is the background a mark is shown on: light = paper, dark = Mustang Green.

families.name: Emblem
families.blurb: The LR and the mustang. The mark most people will think of as the school.

families.name: Wordmark
families.blurb: The school's full name with the mustang, for anything that speaks for the school as a whole.

families.name: Mustang
families.blurb: The horse on its own — the smallest, most flexible piece of the system.

families.name: Band
families.blurb: The emblem in band uniform, so the programme reads as part of the school.

families.name: Grad Mark
families.blurb: A ceremonial crest, founded 1998, for the moments that should feel permanent.

families.name: Mustangs Ahead
families.blurb: One name across the school's own publications, in print and in audio.

families.name: Retro
families.blurb: Collegiate throwbacks for heritage merchandise and anniversaries.

marks.name: Emblem
marks.note: The LR and the mustang in full colour. The default wherever the school needs one mark — athletics, uniforms, the website, anything official.

marks.name: Emblem — large mustang
marks.note: The same lockup with the mustang drawn larger and further over the R, for places where the horse should lead the mark.

marks.name: Emblem — letters only
marks.note: The LR without the mustang, for sizes the horse will not survive — small embroidery, favicons, stitched tags.

marks.name: Emblem — one colour
marks.note: Single-ink reproduction: embroidery, etching, laser, and any print that cannot hold two colours.

marks.name: Emblem — reversed
marks.note: For green and dark grounds only. Never place the reversed emblem on a light background.

marks.name: Wordmark — stacked
marks.note: The mustang above the school name. The formal lockup for anything that speaks for the school as a whole.

marks.name: Wordmark — horizontal
marks.note: The mustang and the school name side by side, centred. Letterhead, email, the website header — anywhere wide.

marks.name: Wordmark — left-aligned
marks.note: The mustang beside the school name, set left-aligned. For the shallowest spaces: banners, pole signs, the top of a form.

marks.name: Mustang — two colour
marks.note: The full-detail mustang in black and white, for paper and light backgrounds.

marks.name: Mustang — one colour
marks.note: The single-ink mustang. Also the watermark ghosted behind other artwork.

marks.name: Mustang — badge
marks.note: The mustang in a Mustang Green disc. Social avatars, app icons, stickers — anywhere the crop is a circle.

marks.name: Mustang — keylined
marks.note: The two-colour mustang inside a white keyline, so it holds on green, black and photographs.

marks.name: Band emblem
marks.note: The emblem with the mustang in a band shako. Uniforms, drum heads, instrument cases.

marks.name: Band lockup
marks.note: The band emblem with the staff and the Mustang Band name. Trailers, banners, concert programmes.

marks.name: Crest
marks.note: The rearing mustang and shield, founded 1998. Diplomas, graduation programmes, awards — anything that should feel permanent.

marks.name: Crest — light
marks.note: The crest in a lighter colourway, with a paler mustang and a grey top banner, where the full-colour crest reads too heavy.

marks.name: Crest — one colour
marks.note: The crest in Mustang Green alone, for embossing, foil stamping and single-ink print.

marks.name: Newsletter — disc
marks.note: The newsletter's round mark on the Mustang Green field. Covers, avatars, the top of every issue.

marks.name: Newsletter — horizontal
marks.note: The newsletter mark set wide in white, for mastheads and headers on dark grounds.

marks.name: Podcast — disc
marks.note: The podcast's round cover mark. Show artwork and episode thumbnails.

marks.name: Podcast — horizontal
marks.note: The podcast mark set wide in white, for banners and video end cards on dark grounds.

marks.name: Podcast — black
marks.note: The podcast disc on black, for dark interfaces and anywhere the green disc would sit on more green.

marks.name: Mustangs Ahead — tile
marks.note: The Mustangs Ahead name on a green tile, est. 1998. Square avatars and the corner of a page.

marks.name: Retro — mustang head
marks.note: The mustang head beside LRHS in collegiate block letters. Throwback spirit wear and reunion merchandise.

marks.name: Retro — rearing mustang
marks.note: The classic rearing mustang beside LRHS. Heritage use — reunions, anniversaries, vintage-style apparel.

retired.name: Old emblem
retired.note: The previous emblem. Kept on file so it can be recognised and replaced — not for use in new work.

retired.name: Old horse
retired.note: A previous horse drawing. Reference only.

retired.name: Old horse II
retired.note: A previous horse drawing. Reference only.

retired.name: Old horse III
retired.note: A previous horse drawing. Reference only.
